system: Yokohama System for Reporting Breast Fine Needle Aspiration Biopsy Cytopathology

yokohama_i_insufficient_inadequate.patientTitle: The breast sample was not enough for a clear diagnosis
yokohama_i_insufficient_inadequate.plainLanguageSummary: The breast sample did not contain enough useful cells, or the sample quality was limited, so a clear diagnosis could not be made.
yokohama_i_insufficient_inadequate.whatThisMeans: This does not mean cancer was found. It means the sample was not adequate enough to provide a reliable answer.
yokohama_i_insufficient_inadequate.possibleNextSteps: Your doctor may recommend repeat FNA, core biopsy, imaging review, or further assessment depending on the breast lump and imaging findings.
yokohama_i_insufficient_inadequate.safetyNote: This summary is for general understanding only. Please discuss the full report with your doctor, who will interpret it together with your symptoms, examination findings, imaging, and previous results where relevant.

yokohama_ii_benign.plainLanguageSummary: The breast sample shows benign, non-cancerous cells.
yokohama_ii_benign.whatThisMeans: This is generally reassuring, but breast results are usually interpreted together with clinical examination and imaging.
yokohama_ii_benign.possibleNextSteps: Your doctor will correlate this with breast imaging and examination. Follow-up, repeat sampling, or core biopsy may still be recommended if the findings do not match.
yokohama_ii_benign.safetyNote: This summary is for general understanding only. Please discuss the full report with your doctor, who will interpret it together with your symptoms, examination findings, imaging, and previous results where relevant.

yokohama_iii_atypical.plainLanguageSummary: The breast sample shows some cells that look unusual, but the findings are not enough to diagnose cancer.
yokohama_iii_atypical.whatThisMeans: This is an indeterminate result. It may require further assessment to exclude a more significant lesion.
yokohama_iii_atypical.possibleNextSteps: Your doctor may recommend core biopsy, repeat sampling, imaging correlation, or specialist breast clinic review.
yokohama_iii_atypical.safetyNote: This summary is for general understanding only. Please discuss the full report with your doctor, who will interpret it together with your symptoms, examination findings, imaging, and previous results where relevant.

yokohama_iv_suspicious_for_malignancy.plainLanguageSummary: The breast sample shows changes that are suspicious for cancer, but may not be sufficient for a definite diagnosis.
yokohama_iv_suspicious_for_malignancy.whatThisMeans: There is significant concern, and further evaluation is usually needed.
yokohama_iv_suspicious_for_malignancy.possibleNextSteps: Your doctor will usually recommend core biopsy, imaging correlation, and specialist breast assessment.
yokohama_iv_suspicious_for_malignancy.safetyNote: This summary is for general understanding only. Please discuss the full report with your doctor, who will interpret it together with your symptoms, examination findings, imaging, and previous results where relevant.

yokohama_v_malignant.patientTitle: Cancer cells identified in the breast sample
yokohama_v_malignant.plainLanguageSummary: The breast sample shows malignant cells, meaning cancer cells were identified.
yokohama_v_malignant.whatThisMeans: This result usually requires specialist breast cancer assessment and treatment planning.
yokohama_v_malignant.possibleNextSteps: Your doctor will arrange correlation with imaging, possible core biopsy or biomarker testing, and referral to the breast cancer care team.
yokohama_v_malignant.safetyNote: This summary is for general understanding only. Please discuss the full report with your doctor, who will interpret it together with your symptoms, examination findings, imaging, and previous results where relevant.
